Untrusted content: truth_sources_register, youtube_connector, klaviyo_connector, mailchimp_connector, search_console_connector, web_fetch_connector, axonaut_connector, close_connector, bing_webmaster_connector, podium_connector, email_connector, featured_seo_audit, featured_sales_call_prep_brief · Private data: truth_sources_list, truth_sources_register, truth_sources_remove, slack_connector, constantcontact_connector, activecampaign_connector, odoo_connector, airtable_connector, posthog_connector, stripe_connector, close_connector, salesforce_connector, podium_connector, drive_connector, database_connector, crm_connector, featured_sales_call_prep_brief, featured_executive_summary_writer, reset_connector_token, logout_all, get_user_statistics · Public sink: cross_source_email_connector, google_ads_connector, klaviyo_connector, mailchimp_connector, constantcontact_connector, activecampaign_connector, postscript_connector, axonaut_connector, email_connector, featured_cash_recovery_engine, featured_sales_call_prep_brief · Destructive: truth_sources_remove, metric_spec_remove, resolve_connector, run_runbook, invoke_skill, database_connector, featured_seo_audit, featured_competitive_intelligence_brief, featured_cash_recovery_engine, featured_sales_call_prep_brief, featured_executive_summary_writer, reset_connector_token, logout_all.
